subject.title: fix(models): keep dynamic model lists consistent across CLI and Gateway

question: Do maintainers approve moving generated provider catalogs, including catalog-embedded credentials and account routes, from released agent sidecars into the per-agent SQLite cache with Doctor as the sole upgrade-repair owner?
rationale: This is a persistent auth/provider-state ownership decision with upgrade consequences that tests and the branch description cannot settle without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the SQLite migration boundary
options.body: Accept agent SQLite as the canonical persistent owner after confirming the existing secret-storage and Doctor recovery contracts cover this data.

options.title: Keep catalog payloads out of agent SQLite
options.body: Retain or redesign the storage boundary if catalog-embedded credential material must remain in a different protected store.

recommendation.title: Approve the SQLite migration boundary
recommendation.body: Accept agent SQLite as the canonical persistent owner after confirming the existing secret-storage and Doctor recovery contracts cover this data.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this contributor directly to the proposed model-catalog and migration design.
